shorts.title: This Bird Flew 11 Days Without Stopping 🐦
shorts.description:
This bird flew eleven days without stopping. Shorebirds like godwits can carry fat loads of 35-40% of their body mass for the trip.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Bar-tailed godwit: William Harland (CC BY), Настя Бухвалова (CC BY), Tommy Andriollo (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: How far could you go nonstop?

shorts.title: The Peregrine Falcon Punches Prey With Its Foot 🦅
shorts.description:
This falcon dives faster than highway traffic. Peregrines were wiped out across much of their range by DDT; the US took them off the endangered list in 1999.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Peregrine falcon: Brooke J. (CC BY), Shirley Zundell (CC BY), Jeff Young (CC BY), Surabhi Srivastava (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: This Lizard Drinks Through Its Skin 🦎
shorts.description:
This lizard drinks through its skin. Its color shifts from pale in warm weather to dark in cold weather.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Thorny devil: Connor Margetts (CC BY), c_knut_lord (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Would you rather drink with your feet or your skin?

shorts.title: This Parrot Takes Cars Apart 🦜
shorts.description:
This parrot takes cars apart. Kea are endangered, with an estimated 3,000-7,000 left.

shorts.title: No Monarch Butterfly Makes the Round Trip 🦋
shorts.description:
No monarch butterfly makes the round trip. Monarchs may steer by detecting polarized ultraviolet light from the sky.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment: Have you ever seen a monarch up close?

shorts.title: The Firefly That Flashes for a Darker Reason ✨
shorts.description:
Some fireflies flash to find a date. There are at least 64 recognized Photuris species, all in temperate North America.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths
